presentation: Hanae Belmajdoub is a faculty member at FSJES-Souissi, Mohammed V University in Rabat, and a permanent member of LRIT. She defended her PhD in Computer Science and Telecommunications on 2 December 2023 at the Faculty of Sciences of Rabat.

Her research focuses on artificial intelligence, deep learning and image processing, particularly the detection and monitoring of coastal upwelling using satellite data, as well as applications in health and spatiotemporal data.
Her teaching covers algorithms, programming, digital skills, web technologies and data analysis tools. She contributes to final-year project supervision and the laboratory’s scientific activities.

presentation: Khalid Minaoui is a professor at the Faculty of Sciences of Rabat, Mohammed V University, and has been director of LRIT since 2022. He also coordinates the research Master’s in Computer Science and Telecommunications.

His research focuses on signal and image processing, artificial intelligence and their applications. It includes satellite image analysis for coastal upwelling observation, mobility modelling and learning methods for data analysis.
His activities combine research, teaching and doctoral supervision. At LRIT, he supports research projects and doctoral training in collaboration with the laboratory’s faculty and partners.

presentation: Salma Mouline is a professor in the Computer Science Department at the Faculty of Sciences of Rabat, Mohammed V University, and a permanent member of LRIT. She obtained her PhD in Computer Science at Pierre Mendès France University in Grenoble in 1994.

Her research focuses on software engineering, information systems, model engineering and formal verification of complex systems. Her publications also address recommender systems, big data and network modelling.
Her teaching includes object-oriented design with UML, model engineering and databases. She contributes to doctoral supervision at LRIT and to the laboratory’s scientific collaborations.
